'''Malkii''' was a remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. It commonly served as a refuge for [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], insurrectionists and terrorists, but perhaps it was most notorious for its reputation as the training ground of the infamous [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] known as [[Malkite Poisoners]].
